integrity.known_computation_limits: 330 exact checks cover degrees 1 through 11 only and do not prove the general theorem.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytical boundary identity, Legendre-root simplicity, parity and asymptotics; reproducible exact finite symbolic calculations are supplementary.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats fixed exact spherical-harmonic degree on S^2 and polar caps strictly smaller than a hemisphere.
Coincidences between nonconsecutive absolute azimuthal orders are not classified.
The exact number of crossing radii counts indexed adjacent pairs; distinct crossing radii for different pairs need not be distinct.
Identical absolute-order levels may carry two Fourier azimuthal eigenvectors; a three-level resonance need not have geometric multiplicity three.
The work is not an independent verification of scientific priority; potentially relevant 1974 associated-Legendre integrals were not fully inspected.
title: Exact angular-order crossings and triple resonances in single-degree spherical-cap localization
